title: Issue forms with an Edition field (Community / Cloud / Enterprise): this repository is the one public issue tracker for ObjectOS, and triage needs to tell the editions apart
body:
Filing gate ③ for the premise, filer's proposal for the mechanism. Maintainer (Sam, `os-zhuang`), 2026-10-26 13:47Z, verbatim: 「如果品牌不分开，issue tracker 应该就是 objectstack 仓库了」 — under the edition model ruled at 13:18Z (ObjectOS Community / Cloud / Enterprise, one brand; ObjectStack the protocol and SDK name), this repository is the single public issue tracker for the product, including issues from Cloud and Enterprise users whose code lives in a private repository. The mechanism — an issue form with an Edition dropdown — is the filer's proposal to make that triageable; the maintainer has not ruled on the form itself. Business reason: a Cloud user's report ("Build & Ask drafted an object that 404s") and a Community self-hoster's report ("`os start` fails on Postgres 17") land in the same inbox; without a declared edition the triage seat reads each body to decide whether the card belongs here or moves to the cloud repository, and a Cloud report filed as a framework bug sits in the wrong lane. Reader: the `domain:devx` seat dispatches one dev; file surface `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` (new), `CONTRIBUTING.md` (one paragraph). Dedupe: `is:issue "issue template" OR "issue form" OR ISSUE_TEMPLATE` → 0 open hits; the repository has no `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` directory at `d1ea2363` (blank issues only). Session `session_01FMuBZmssbfQkVrKRtxNvng`; siblings: objectstack-ai/docs.objectos.ai#338 (its README routes product issues here — scope amendment of today), objectstack-ai/objectstack#26129 (root README; may add the one "report an issue" line if its reviewer agrees — not this card's).

## Scope

1. `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug-report.yml` and `feature-request.yml` (GitHub issue forms, YAML): fields — **Edition** (dropdown: ObjectOS Community (self-hosted, this repository's code) / ObjectOS Cloud (cloud.objectos.ai) / ObjectOS Enterprise (licensed, self-managed) / Not sure), **Version** (the `os --version` / Console About string; free text), **What happened / What you expected**, **Steps** — and nothing else. The Edition field is `required: true`.
2. `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml`: `blank_issues_enabled: true` (pm-dispatch seats file through the relay with their own body shape — the forms are for users, not for seats), one contact link to the documentation site.
3. `CONTRIBUTING.md`: one paragraph — this repository is the public tracker for every edition; say the edition; Cloud and Enterprise reports are triaged by the cloud seat and may be moved.
4. Labels: none added by the form (the triage seat labels). If the seat wants an `edition:*` label family, that is a one-line follow-up, not this card.

## Premises (re-check before dispatch)

- P1 — `ls .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE` → no such directory at `d1ea2363`.
- P2 — `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**` is not a governed path (`check-governed-merges.mjs` governs `.github/workflows/**` only).

## Acceptance

- Opening "New issue" on the repository offers Bug report / Feature request / blank; the Bug report form refuses submission without an Edition.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` names the one-tracker rule in one paragraph.

## 维护者速读

按你 13:47 的「issue tracker 应该就是 objectstack 仓库」：一个品牌一个入口后，Cloud 用户和 Community 自托管用户的问题会进同一个箱子。本卡给 objectstack 仓加两个 issue 表单，必填「版本：Community / Cloud / Enterprise」，分诊席按它分流；空白 issue 保留给席位走中继立卡。表单本身是我的提案，不是你的原话，不同意就裁掉。
